chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Grief is half of old age.

key_terms.الْهَرَم: Old age, specifically the stage of life marked by physical decline

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of grief on a person's aging process according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) metaphorically equates grief to half of old age, emphasizing its debilitating impact on both body and soul. Shia scholars often interpret 'al-haram' (old age) here not merely as chronological aging, but as the premature decay of vitality and vigor caused by persistent sorrow. This teaching serves as a spiritual reminder to cultivate sabr (patience) and dhikr (remembrance) to preserve one's inner and outer youth.
